# Workspace guide

This guide explains how teams organize and govern documents in a workspace.

## Create a workspace

Choose a short, recognizable workspace name.

Names may contain letters, numbers, and hyphens.

Select the region closest to most collaborators.

## Organize documents

Create folders for stable subject areas.

Use tags for temporary initiatives and cross-team projects.

Avoid folder structures deeper than three levels.

## Invite collaborators

Open **Workspace settings** and select **Members**.

Enter one email address per collaborator or paste a comma-separated list.

Invitations expire after fourteen days.

## Search and discovery

Search indexes titles, body text, tags, and attachment names.

Quoted searches require an exact phrase.

Recently viewed documents appear before older matches.

## Archive a workspace

Export important documents before archiving.

Archived workspaces remain readable for ninety days.
